title: VHF Relay: UNDSS Beira — Logistics Cluster Boat to Buzi, One Seat

fields.centerName: HRI Beira Country Office — Radio Room

lines.text: HRI Beira, HRI Beira, this is UNDSS Beira. Rui, are you on? Over.
UNDSS Beira, HRI Beira. Rui here. Go ahead. Over.

Rui, UNDSS. I have the skipper of the Logistics Cluster boat on INGD's Buzi run on the other channel. He's at the Beira fish market quay. He will carry your staff's last known location. Buzi town and Guara-Guara, 19:40 last night, white HRI four-by-four, three people. He'll ask at the Buzi district administration and at the school on the high ground. Departure is about 09:00. The river is fast, so he expects to reach Buzi town around 11:00 and to call in on the satellite phone between 11:15 and 11:30. Nothing sooner. Over.
Copied. Departure 09:00, sat phone call 11:15 to 11:30. Over.

There's one spare seat outbound. If HRI wants to put someone on it, the name has to be at the quay by 08:45, with your organisation's movement approval. INGD will not carry unauthorised NGO staff. I say again, 08:45. On the Guara-Guara story: the police have a vehicle at the crossing, but nobody has confirmed the make, the colour or the owner yet. Not confirmed. One more thing. A family member of one of your people is at the quay asking to board. We've told him no. You may want to call him. UNDSS Beira standing by for your answer on the seat. Over.

fields.voiceStyle: Male UN security officer in his forties, steady and clipped, practised radio voice, slightly hurried by the 08:45 deadline but calm

instructorNote: This is the key decision point of the phase. Watch whether the SFP keeps the team listed as out of contact and Buzi movements stopped, and whether the CD makes a recorded decision on the seat, with a signed movement approval by 08:45, and says what it means for the national staff involved. Twelve hours after the last check-in, the CD should brief the CMT chair, who opens a timed decision log and assigns a family liaison to call all three families, including the relative at the quay. No message should link HRI to the unconfirmed Guara-Guara vehicle.
